name: RoPE + QK-Norm + Per-Head Temp
tagline: Adds a learnable per-head log-temperature on top of RoPE+QK-Norm so each head can self-tune attention sharpness.

key_hyperparams.name: α_h (attn_logit_scale)
key_hyperparams.role: log per-head temperature multiplier on Q

diff_from_baseline: Vs rope_qk_norm: adds per-head learnable temperature exp(α_h) multiplied into Q after RoPE so each head can sharpen or soften attention independently of the standard 1/sqrt(d_k) scale; everything else (RMSNorm before RoPE, no learned positional emb) is unchanged.

name: AFS-RoPE + QK-Norm
tagline: Multiplies each RoPE inverse-frequency by a learnable per-pair scale; QK-Norm applied before rotation.

key_hyperparams.name: freq_scales (s)
key_hyperparams.role: learnable per-frequency-pair multiplier on RoPE base frequencies

diff_from_baseline: Vs rope_qk_norm: makes the RoPE inverse-frequency vector learnable via per-dimension multiplicative scales (Adaptive Frequency Scaling) so the model can stretch or compress the rotational schedule; QK-Norm (RMSNorm) is applied before AFS-RoPE.

name: Token-Shift + RoPE + Per-Head Temp
tagline: Mixes each token's QKV with its left neighbor via a learnable gate, then applies QK-Norm, RoPE, and a learnable per-head temperature.

key_hyperparams.name: τ (time_mix)
key_hyperparams.role: per-channel mixing weight between current and shifted token

init_recovers: Approaches RoPE+QK-Norm when τ→1 and s_h=1
diff_from_baseline: Vs rope_qk_norm: precedes QKV with an RWKV-style token-shift mix (learnable per-channel gate τ between current and previous token), then applies the standard QK-Norm + RoPE pipeline plus a learnable per-head temperature s_h on Q.

name: Differential Rotary + Recency Bias
tagline: RoPE+QK-Norm with separate learnable Q/K gains and a learnable per-head linear recency bias added to attention logits.

key_hyperparams.name: g_h^Q, g_h^K
key_hyperparams.role: decoupled per-head gains on RMS-normalized Q and K

key_hyperparams.name: ρ_h (recency_scale)
key_hyperparams.role: per-head non-negative slope for linear recency bias

init_recovers: RoPE + QK-Norm at gains=1 and ρ=0
diff_from_baseline: Vs rope_qk_norm: separates the QK-Norm scale into independent per-head Q and K gains, switches RoPE to interleaved (even/odd) pairing of dimensions, and adds a per-head ALiBi-style linear recency bias attn_logits -= ReLU(ρ_h)·|i-j| (passed through SDPA's attn_mask).

name: NTK-RoPE + QK-Norm + Cached Cos/Sin
tagline: QK-Norm + RoPE with NTK-aware base = 10000·(block_size/head_dim) and a precomputed cos/sin cache.

key_hyperparams.name: ntk_factor
key_hyperparams.role: NTK-aware scaling of the RoPE base frequency

key_hyperparams.name: base_freq
key_hyperparams.role: effective RoPE base after NTK rescaling

diff_from_baseline: Vs rope_qk_norm: replaces the constant 10000 RoPE base with an NTK-aware base 10000·(block_size/head_dim) so frequencies are stretched for the 1024 context length, and precomputes the (cos,sin) cache for the full block size; QK-Norm is unchanged.
